mechanism: Cholecalciferol increases intestinal calcium absorption and primaquine may cause hemolysis in G6PD-deficient patients, potentially exacerbating electrolyte disturbances and increasing risk of hemolytic complications with altered calcium-phosphate metabolism.
action: Monitor serum calcium and phosphate levels; ensure G6PD status is known before primaquine use; maintain adequate hydration and counsel on signs of hemolysis.
